title: Velvety Smoky American Ground Beef Casserole
description: A rich and savory casserole featuring ground beef, smoky spices, and a silky texture, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This dish is halal-friendly and packed with umami flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the smoked paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Stir in the ground pistachios and cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked ground beef mixture, beef broth, and shredded cheddar cheese.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
